Are you a highly motivated multi-disciplinary engineer looking to work on building projects that can change the world, projects that are always more complex and innovative than the last?
We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineer to join our MEP team. This is a hybrid role and you could be based in our London, Croydon, St.Albans, Manchester, Leeds, Exeter, Cardiff or Bristol office to work across a broad range of sectors and for a broad range of clients.  You will be joining a team of like-minded experts that have a passion for innovation and delivering cutting edge solutions.
About Us:
AECOM plays a critical role in the conceptualisation and creation of amazing spaces, delivering projects and buildings that define skylines and communities. AECOM Buildings & Places – Design  is made up of dedicated teams delivering projects in Commercial, Residential, Hospitality, Sports Venues, Work Places, Data Centres, Education, Government, Healthcare and Defence.
We are friendly, busy and motivated with an established track record of successfully delivering local and overseas projects. Some of our flagship work in recent years include:
• Healthcare: AECOM is a leading award-winning consultant for the NHS in the UK and internationally, delivering projects ranging from major acute hospitals to primary care and estate refurbishment schemes, while supporting the NHS Net Zero Carbon agenda.
• Decarbonisation: Multiple projects where we have undertaken the feasibility of the removal of boilers and installation of Air Source and Water source heat pumps to provide the heating and cooling for the building. Projects include commercial buildings like 80 – 100 Victoria Street London, British Library, multiple residential buildings in the Royal Borough of Greenwich and even Windsor Castle.
• Stratford Cross: A major mixed-use regeneration development in Stratford, East London, located within the former Olympic Park area. Our team are providing multi-discipline services including MEP, civil & structural, vertical transportation, energy & sustainability, acoustics, air quality, ecology, transport, waste management, and façade engineering.
• Data Centres: Working for multiple major hyperscale projects in the Nordics, Iberia and South America. These projects provide the opportunity to tackle the issue of data management and storage specific to each country. Designing and implementing a highly resilient electrical infrastructure entails the usage of an efficient system that is highly sustainable.
• Lansdowne House: High-end commercial office development occupying the South-East side of Berkley Square, Mayfair, City of Westminster, with an all- electric energy centre containing Ground Source Heat Pumps, Air Source Heat Pumps and High Efficiency Chillers.
• 10 Dock: Western Europe’s largest naval dockyard in Plymouth, a defence project of enormous scale and multiple components that must come together as a solution to meet a new capability.
About Our Team:
Our award-winning and close-knit Building Services team have a strong presence across sectors and we have and a strong Public Health engineering team throughout the UK. The team is seeking to expand their capabilities further by adding a Senior Public Health Engineer with experience in delivering sustainable projects across multiple sectors, has excellent team working and co-ordination skills and strives for technical excellence.
You will be an integral part of the diverse and dynamic national AECOM PH team which will support your technical career development. Challenges such as the net zero agenda and water neutrality provide great opportunities for your career to flourish with the role also including Fire Protection systems design which will be supported by our experienced specialist fire protection engineering team to provide the opportunity to develop new design skills. The position is predominantly office located role to ensure face-to-face contact time with the team.
The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading much of the Public Health and Fire Protection systems design on projects and involve client liaison, mentoring and leading the discipline/systems to prepare scheme and detailed engineering designs. The successful candidate will have proven design experience, delivering to quality, time and budget. This role will suit someone with who is enthusiastic, self-motivated, and looking to advance their career.
The role will include taking point lead on multiple PH systems design/calculations on a project as well as assisting the lead PH engineer with experience in the following systems:
• Hot and cold water systems
• Above ground foul and rainwater system
• Fire Protection Systems
• Below Ground drainage systems
• Pumped drainage systems
• Water and oil leak detection systems
• Rainwater harvesting and Greywater recycling systems
• Water conservation solutions
• BREEAM, LEED and Ska Rating design integration
Duties of the role will include, but not be limited to;
• Maintaining Client relationships
• Mentoring and developing staff
• Project Managing small sized multi-disciplinary projects
• Obtain the necessary information both internally and externally from Architects, Quantity Surveyors and Design Consultants to provide a fully coordinated design
• Ensure the Design Team is kept fully informed of all technical and other information necessary for the duration of the project
• Be familiar with the BIM design process and be capable of input and support for projects designed in Revit
• Ensure compliance with all Statutory and Regulatory obligations, make submissions to the Statutory Authorities and obtain approvals as necessary
• Produce all design information and ensure that all calculations are prepared and signed off in accordance with the requirements of the QA procedures, relevant Standards and Codes of Practice
• Represent AECOM at Client, Design Team and Progress meetings throughout the design and construction phases of projects
• Support AECOM PM with input to pre-qualification and selection of contractors, also respond to tender queries, comment and review tender returns
• Ensure the project work complies with the Project Management Plan and Programme
• Understand and implement AECOM’s Safety Health and Environment Policy
Minimum Requirements:
• Previous public health engineering work experience within design consultancy or other relevant business
• A comprehensive working knowledge of statutory regulations to ensure design compliance, make submissions to the statutory authorities and obtaining approvals as necessary
• Be able to work independently and have good time/task management skills
• Experience in mixed used, residential, commercial and healthcare buildings/sectors
• Fully competent in the use of AutoCad to produce 2D drawings
• Fully competence in using 3D Revit software and Navisworks reviewing software
• Ability to speak fluently and communicate effectively in written reports and oral presentations

About This Job
We are seeking a talented Reactor System Design Engineer to join a highly innovative engineering team working on the development of next-generation nuclear technology.
This role will focus on the design and development of Reactor Island systems, including primary and secondary circuit systems, from early concept definition through to detailed design. You'll work within a multidisciplinary environment, collaborating with technical specialists and stakeholders to develop safe, efficient, and compliant system architectures.
This is an excellent opportunity for a Process Engineer or System Design Engineer with 4-8 years' experience looking to work on complex, high-impact engineering projects.
Key Responsibilities:
• Lead the design and development of Reactor Island systems, including primary and secondary circuit systems.
• Develop system concepts and mature designs through both concept and detailed design phases.
• Produce and maintain key design documentation, including:
• System Design Descriptions (SDDs)
• Requirements Specifications
• P&IDs
• Functional Bills of Materials (FBoMs)
• Engineering calculations
• Decision logs and optioneering studies
• Define system requirements and develop compliant system architectures.
• Conduct technical calculations for system and component sizing.
• Engage with multidisciplinary stakeholders to ensure requirements are captured and integrated effectively.
• Present technical design solutions at formal design reviews and stage-gate assessments.
• Ensure designs meet safety, regulatory and operational requirements through the application of Design for X principles.

Qualifications
Required Skills:
• 4-8 years' experience in process or systems engineering.
• Experience applying process system design principles on complex engineering projects.
• Ownership of system designs through concept and detailed design phases.
• Experience producing:
• System requirements
• System description/design reports
• Process flow diagrams
• P&IDs
• Engineering calculations
• Strong technical stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Experience carrying out system optioneering and technical trade-off studies.
Required Qualifications:
• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, or equivalent military experience.
Desirable Skills:
• Nuclear industry experience.
• Sampling systems design experience.
• Experience with reactor, thermal-hydraulic, utility, or process systems.
• Knowledge of regulated industries such as nuclear, defence, energy, oil & gas, or chemicals.
• Familiarity with systems engineering methodologies and requirements management.

Additional Information
Why join us?
We bring together entrepreneurial, tech-driven people to deliver innovative solutions for leading companies.
At ALTEN, you’ll work on exciting projects, supported by ongoing learning, mentoring, and clear career development tailored to your goals.
Join a passionate team and help build tomorrow, today.
In short you get:
• A personalised career path and a rewarding management style
• A huge diversity of engineering projects and industries
• Private Medical Insurance
• Cycle & Tech Scheme
• Employee assistance programme
• Life insurance & Pension Scheme
• Social atmosphere, regular gatherings & team buildings
• Flexible way of working (role dependent)

We recognise the value of military skills and experience and are committed to ensuring that no applicant is unfairly disadvantaged during our recruitment and selection processes.
ALTEN is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and values the strength that comes from a global mix of backgrounds and perspectives. jobs.smartrecruiters.com/aecom2/74400015.description_excerpt:
About This Job
AECOM’s Ports and Maritime team is seeking a Graduate Ports Engineer with a civil and structural academic background to support in a technical role across multiple UK and international projects.
You’ll join an established team with over 200 years of combined experience, delivering world-class maritime and coastal infrastructure. Our portfolio includes projects for local authorities, private developers, defence clients, and internal AECOM teams in the UK and overseas.
As a Graduate Ports Engineer, you will develop and learn the skills to undertake design, analysis and supervision of civil and structural works, in the marine and coastal environment. Typical projects include the development, rehabilitation, and protection of port and harbour structures such as quay walls, jetties, piers, revetments, breakwaters, dolphins, fendering systems, linkspan supports, and scour protection.
You’ll contribute to all stages of the project lifecycle — from concept and feasibility through to detailed design and construction support — ensuring solutions are safe, sustainable, and compliant with UK and international standards.
We provide industry leading support to different Sectors; Renewable Energy, Decarbonisation of infrastructure, Global Goods Movement, Defence Resilience, Cruise ports, Rehabilitation of historic structures, Marinas, Waterfront Development, Fishing Industry and Ferry Terminal to keep communities connected, these are some of them.
You will be working in a supportive team learning to deliver, developing your skills and experience in:
• Structural design and analysis of maritime and coastal structures using relevant design codes (BS, Eurocodes, PIANC, CIRIA, ICE guidance).
• Using current computer software (including but not limited to ROBOT, GRLWEAP, WALLAP, TEDDS, PLAXIS 3D and others).
• Developing concept, preliminary, and detailed designs for new build and refurbishment projects, including quay walls, jetties, revetments, breakwaters, dolphins, linkspans, and related works.
• Carrying out stability, bearing capacity, and durability assessments of marine structures under wave, current, and corrosion effects.
• Designing and specifying fendering systems, mooring arrangements, and scour protection measures.
• Prepare and review technical reports, design drawings, specifications, and tender documentation.
• Conducting site inspections and structural condition surveys and prepare inspection reports.
• Liaising effectively with clients, contractors, port authorities, and regulatory bodies.
• Collaborating with geotechnical, hydraulic, environmental, and coastal process engineers across multidisciplinary teams.
• Understand and learn compliance with Health & Safety, Environmental, and CDM Regulations.
• Providing technical support during construction, review contractor submissions, and respond to site queries.
• Contributing to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team.
Come grow with us — and help design the future of resilient coastal and port infrastructure.

Qualifications
Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?
Here’s what we’re looking for:
• BEng (hons) in Civil, Structural with a 2:1 (or equivalent) or above or any Maritime Engineering qualification similar
• MEng (hons) in Civil, Structural would be an advantage
• Ideally, a final year project related to Port, Marine or Coastal Engineering would be advantageous
• Familiarity with relevant British Standards, and Eurocodes.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to liaise with multidisciplinary teams and clients.
• You must have the right to work in the UK and be able to achieve SC clearance with no Caveats (UK National Only)

Additional Information
• Applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible since CVs will be reviewed, and candidates selected on a rolling recruitment basis for either immediate or advanced offer start.
• Please include a covering letter with your application and provide all predicted and/or obtained academic grades and details of the dates you are able to work to/from and well as locations you would be interested in.
• You must have the right to work in the UK and be able to achieve SC clearance with no Caveats (UK National Only)
At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.
About AECOM
AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity
You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.
You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.
AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.
Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

Broaden and deepen the Bank’s distribution and investor network across banks, non-bank financial institutions, development finance institutions, credit insurers, private credit and private equity credit funds, fixed-income and emerging-market debt funds, asset managers, family offices, insurance investors and other institutional capital providers.
•
Develop and maintain a detailed investor appetite and market-intelligence framework, ensuring likely funding sources are identified early and that investor requirements inform transaction development, pricing, structuring and marketing.
•
Execute distribution strategies for trade-finance assets and facilities on a funded and unfunded basis, including the preparation and coordination of transaction summaries, teasers, information memoranda, investor presentations, data rooms and other marketing materials.
•
Act as a subject-matter expert for the placement of structured finance and commodity finance risk, assessing distributability and marketability across cash flows, collateral, borrowing-base mechanics, security arrangements, credit enhancement, repayment sources and other relevant risk mitigants.
•
Work with Origination, Structuring and Coverage to convert opportunities into fundable, executable and investor-ready transactions, including commodity finance, structured credit, portfolio solutions, risk-sharing structures and other transactions designed to mobilise institutional capital.
•
Identify and structure appropriate combinations of bank funding, institutional capital, development finance and credit insurance to support transactions requiring multiple sources of risk capacity.
•
Manage syndication opportunities end to end, including opportunity assessment, syndication strategy, client pitches, approval materials, syndicate formation, investor engagement, documentation, execution, financial close and any post-closing sell-down.
•
Coordinate lender and investor communications throughout syndication and distribution processes, ensuring consistent, accurate and timely information is provided and that confidentiality, due diligence, pricing, allocation and closing processes are managed effectively.
•
Collaborate with Coverage, Product, Credit, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Finance and other stakeholders to identify opportunities early, support cross-selling, capture client flows and ensure transactions meet the Bank’s credit, legal, regulatory, operational and commercial objectives.
•
Monitor market developments across syndicated lending, private credit, structured finance, commodity finance, credit insurance and emerging-market fixed income, identifying trends that may affect investor appetite, pricing or transaction structures.
•
Represent the Bank with investors, clients and market participants at meetings, conferences and external forums, including acting as a public speaker, panellist or Bank representative when required and where significant travel may be necessary.

Qualifications
Qualification
•
Relevant degree, professional qualification or equivalent experience in banking, finance, capital markets, credit, structured finance, trade finance or a related discipline.
•
Fluency in written and spoken English is essential; fluency in one or more additional languages is desirable.

Minimum five years’ relevant experience in syndications, distribution, structured finance, commodity finance, private credit placement, emerging-market credit or a closely related role, preferably with direct emerging-markets exposure.
•
Demonstrable track record of distributing or placing trade finance, structured finance and commodity finance risk across bank, insurance, development finance and institutional investor channels.
•
Established access to buy-side investors and alternative capital providers, including private credit funds, asset managers, specialist trade and commodity funds, family offices and insurance investors.
•
Strong technical knowledge of trade-finance products, primary loan syndication, funded and unfunded participations, assignments, secondary loan sales, credit insurance and banking operations.
•
Strong understanding of credit risk, transaction structuring, risk allocation, pricing, investor requirements and the full execution cycle from market sounding through to documentation, allocation and closing.
•

Entrepreneurial, commercially focused and proactive, with strong relationship-building, communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.

About This Job
This is a 14 month Fixed Term Contract role.
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.
Kamusta, hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
Where and how you can work
This role is based in London with 2-3 days in the office. The buzzing Canva London campus features several buildings around beautiful leafy Hoxton Square in Shoreditch. While our global headquarters is in Sydney, Australia, London is our HQ for Europe, with all kinds of teams based here, plus event spaces to gather our team and communities. You'll experience a warm welcome from our Vibe team at front of house, amazing home cooked food from our Head Chef, and a variety of workspaces to hang out with your team mates or get solo work done. That said, we trust our Canvanauts to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals and so you have choice in where and how you work.
About the role
As our Talent Acquisition Lead for EMEA, you’ll lead the regional Talent Acquisition team of 5 and be a strategic partner to leaders shaping Canva’s growth across a vastly expanding region as we enter new markets.
This is a rare opportunity to have visible, hands-on impact during a defining period for Canva in EMEA. You’ll lead a talented team while helping shape how we enter new countries, build local capability and scale sustainably across one of Canva’s fastest-growing regions. The work will be varied, commercially meaningful and highly connected to the region’s growth agenda.
EMEA is entering an exciting phase of expansion. As we grow in existing markets and establish Canva in new ones, you’ll help turn ambitious growth plans into clear, achievable talent strategies. You’ll partner closely with regional leaders and Country Managers to understand what capabilities they need, where we should hire, and the best ways to build those teams.
This is a role for someone who is comfortable creating clarity in complexity. You’ll balance competing priorities across markets and specialties, connect regional needs with global teams, and help leaders make thoughtful decisions about where to focus our hiring efforts.
What you’d be doing in this role
As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
At the moment, this role is focused on:
•
Being a strategic thought partner to EMEA regional leadership and Country Managers, bringing a strong talent perspective to workforce priorities, challenging assumptions and helping turn ambitious growth and market-entry plans into practical hiring strategies.
•
Helping shape EMEA’s talent acquisition operating model as the region scales, establishing practical, repeatable approaches for new-market hiring while preserving the local nuance each country needs.
•
Leading and developing a high-performing regional TA team, creating clarity on priorities, aligning capacity to the work that matters most and helping the team navigate a fast-moving hiring landscape.
•
Building talent strategies for new and evolving markets, partnering across People, Total Rewards, Legal, Contingent Workforce and other teams to understand local talent, compensation and benefits, worker types and the practicalities of hiring in each country.
•
Creating clarity when priorities compete, connecting regional leaders, Country Managers and global specialty stakeholders when needs aren't naturally aligned and helping the group reach clear, pragmatic decisions.
•
Shaping the right workforce approach, considering permanent, fixed-term and contingent talent based on the market, business need and available hiring pathways.
•
Leading hiring across a broad portfolio of specialties, with priorities spanning areas such as Growth, Marketing, SEO, Content and Customer Service, alongside leadership and other emerging roles.
•
Using market insight to influence decisions, helping leaders understand talent availability, capacity, trade-offs and investment required to deliver against changing hiring priorities.
You're probably a match if
•
You’ve led Talent Acquisition across multiple EMEA markets, ideally supporting international or new-market expansion in high growth environments.
•
You’re a strong people leader who builds high-performing teams through clear direction, trust and coaching.
•
You’re an experienced strategic partner who can influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions and navigate competing priorities.
•
You bring strong commercial and market judgement, balancing business ambition with talent availability, capacity and hiring realities.
•
You’re comfortable with ambiguity and change, creating clarity and momentum when priorities shift.
•
You can move easily between strategy and execution, staying close enough to the work to unblock challenges and drive outcomes.
•
You’re excited by the opportunity to build, not just maintain, bringing structure to new-market expansion while keeping candidate experience and hiring quality high.
What's in it for you?
Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.
Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.
Other stuff to know
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!
Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

About This Job
We are looking for a compassionate and reliable caregiver to join our established team, providing personalised support to an adult living with Muscular Dystrophy, while also supporting other Home Instead clients.
As a Caregiver, you will visit clients in their own homes, supporting them with all aspects of their daily routines while also offering meaningful companionship. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building genuine relationships and making a positive difference in people’s lives.
Our office is based in Worle, Weston-Super-Mare, and we support clients across a wide area, from Burnham-on-Sea to Clevedon and surrounding locations.
This is a rewarding opportunity for someone committed to delivering high-quality, person-centred care, and who values building trusting, respectful relationships.
Key Responsibilities for Muscular Dystrophy client
Providing day-to-day support tailored to the client’s individual needs and preferences
Assisting with manual transfers (no hoisting involved)
Supporting with the use of an electric wheelchair
Driving an adaptive vehicle (training can be provided)
Promoting independence, dignity, and wellbeing at all times
There will be various care visits between 8:00 AM to 9:30 PM. The role is for 3 or 4 weekdays plus every other weekend. Our clients are spread across Weston-Super-Mare, Clevedon, Yatton, Congresbury, Blagdon, Burnham-on-Sea and adjoining areas.
As a Caregiver with Home Instead, you will be visiting Clients in their own homes to help them with all elements of their morning/teatime/evening/bedtime routines and provide meaningful companionship at the same time. This will also involve providing personal care assistance.
We offer:
• Pay rate of £13.40 (before 6pm on weekdays) - £15.20 (after 6pm and all day on weekends) per hour.
• Double pay on Bank Holidays.
• Paid travel time plus paid mileage. Your pay, whenever you need it - take a portion of your pay early, no need to wait until payday.
• Paid holiday, even on a zero-hour contract.
• Paid training and shadowing.
• DBS fee paid
• Regular working pattern with the same Clients.
• 24/7 on call support and a friendly and supportive office team.
• Regular team meetings, training updates and support visits.
• Free qualifications such as NVQ diplomas and Level 2 certificates in a variety of topics PLUS fully funded City & Guilds qualification in Dementia.
• Free polo shirt, rucksack and PPE.
• Free access to our Employee Assistance Programme.
• Staff appreciation schemes and social events.
• Access to our Home Instead benefits.
• Refer a friend bonus scheme and company pension.
This is a fantastic, rewarding role and you will really be making a difference to someone's life.

Qualifications
Ideally you will have experience in supporting individuals with physical disabilities, particularly Muscular Dystrophy (or similar conditions). Personality, compassion and a sense of humour are also important to us, and we will provide you with full training and shadowing.
You will need to be comfortable with manual handling and transfers and willing to learn how to operate specialist equipment, including adaptive vehicles you will need to be open-minded, flexible, and able to adapt to the client’s preferred way of doing things.
Patient, respectful, and able to follow detailed, personalised support guidance
Due to having to travel to clients' own homes, we require candidates to have a UK driving licence and access to their own car.
We provide free ongoing learning and development opportunities such as the Care Certificate, Health and Social Care diplomas and an extensive range of distance learning courses.

Additional Information
We encourage applications from all sections of the community as we want to reflect the neighbourhoods in which we work. Home Instead is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of adults and expects all staff to share this commitment. The home care assistant role is subject to DBS enhanced disclosure.
This role is UK based and the right to work in the UK will need to be established as part of the home care assistant recruitment process.

Key responsibilities include delivering timely and accurate monthly actuals, maintaining the fixed asset register, preparing and optimising balance sheet reconciliations, and providing actionable financial insights to stakeholders across the organisation, while supporting key finance initiatives.

• Support the delivery of interim and year end audit requirements, ensuring all information is accurate, complete, and meets audit standards.
• Drive continuous improvement of the Fixed Asset Register, accounting policies, and processes, collaborating with Finance Tech colleagues where needed.
• Prepare, self review, and continuously improve robust and accurate Balance Sheet reconciliations for Capex related areas at month end.
• Ensure financial controls, processes, and risks relating to Capex are fully documented and regularly updated.

• Identify and implement opportunities to reduce waste and optimise month-end processes.
• Supporting our culture by championing Diversity, Equity & Inclusion strategies.

About This Job
We’re looking for a Risk Lead to join the Global Risk team at Wise and focus on enabling our Wise Assets product to meet its strategic objectives. This is a second line role and will report into the Head of Risk Product Governance.
Wise Assets is an investment product that allows eligible customers to earn a return on their money by investing it in the market rather than holding it as cash. It is a self-directed feature within the Wise multi-currency account where funds are placed into money market funds or stocks managed by third-party fund managers.
YOUR MISSION
You will partner with the Head of Risk Product Governance and the wider Risk organisation to strengthen and continuously evolve the risk management programme supporting Wise Assets.
You will help ensure that risk frameworks are effectively embedded into the product lifecycle, operational processes, and strategic decision-making, while enabling Wise Assets to scale responsibly across multiple jurisdictions.
You will provide independent challenge, oversight and guidance to ensure risks are identified early, appropriately assessed, transparently reported, and effectively managed through enhancements to the control environment.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
•
Implement and embed Wise’s Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF), associated policies, standards and methodologies across the Wise Assets product ecosystem, ensuring alignment with product developments and appropriate prioritisation of regulatory requirements. This will include establishing and maintaining risk appetite for Assets.
•
Partner with first line teams and co-ordinate with regional risk colleagues to ensure risk management practices are consistently applied and operating effectively across product, operational and governance processes.
•
Provide independent second line oversight and challenge on risk assessments, control design, control effectiveness and residual risk decisions relating to Wise Assets activities and initiatives.
•
Support product growth and innovation by reviewing new products, features, market expansions and strategic initiatives, providing pragmatic risk advice and recommending proportionate mitigation strategies.
•
Apply ERMF methodologies, including RCSAs, to drive risk and control mapping and assessment activities, ensuring key risks, controls, dependencies and monitoring mechanisms are clearly identified and maintained.
•
Oversee control assurance activities and monitor the effectiveness of key controls, identifying areas of weakness, emerging risks, or control gaps requiring remediation.
•
Own and coordinate issue management activities for Wise Assets, including tracking remediation plans, challenging delivery timelines, escalating delays or material concerns, and ensuring actions are completed in line with enterprise standards and policy requirements.
•
Monitor key risk indicators, operational incidents, control failures and emerging trends to proactively identify deteriorating risk exposures or areas requiring management intervention.
•
Support the development and delivery of risk training and awareness initiatives across Wise Assets, helping strengthen risk culture and risk ownership within the business.
•
Produce high-quality risk reporting and insights for governance committees and senior stakeholders, ensuring reporting is data-driven, clear, actionable and focused on material risk themes.
•
Report on risks operating outside approved appetite thresholds, including escalation of significant exposures, thematic concerns, or persistent control weaknesses.
•
Provide qualitative and quantitative analysis of incidents, issues and remediation activities impacting Wise Assets, including trend analysis and escalation where required.
•
Consolidate risk insights across regions to support enterprise-wide reporting and contribute to effective decision-making at Group governance forums.
•
Build strong relationships with Product, Compliance, Operations, Engineering, Legal, Audit and Regional Risk teams to ensure risk management supports commercial growth while maintaining robust governance standards.

Qualifications
•
Significant experience within financial services, fintech, banking, wealth management, or investment environments, with a strong track record in first or second line risk management roles.
•
Experience working within or supporting investment products, asset management, brokerage, or regulated investment firms is strongly preferred.
•
Demonstrated experience implementing or operating enterprise risk management frameworks within regulated financial services organisations.
•
Strong understanding of non-financial risk management concepts and methodologies, including operational risk, regulatory risk, conduct risk, financial crime risk and control governance.
•
Proven ability to provide effective independent challenge and escalation while maintaining strong and constructive stakeholder relationships.
•
Experience assessing complex products, operational processes, and control environments in fast-paced or scaling organisations.
•
Strong analytical, data management and reporting skills, including the ability to translate complex risk information into clear, concise and impactful insights for senior management, governance committees and regulators.
•
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across different levels of seniority and functions.
•
A pragmatic, commercially aware and solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to balance effective risk management against business growth and customer outcomes.
•
Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities, deliver to tight timelines and operate effectively in a fast-changing environment.
•
An inquisitive mindset and strong interpersonal skills, with a desire to deeply understand how products operate and how risks evolve as the business scales.
•
Experience working in global and cross-functional environments, particularly within technology-driven or high-growth organisations, would be highly advantageous.

Working hours - 9am to 6pm

The opportunity exists for an experienced civil engineer to join AFRY’s Energy Division within the expanding Thermal and Renewable Energy team in the UK.
You will provide clients with help and support at all project stages, including: technical and economic feasibility studies, technology assessments, technical due diligence reviews, Lenders’ Engineer services, front end engineering design (FEED) studies, owner’s engineer services, engineering-procurement-construction-management (EPCM) services, operation and maintenance support and optimisation and expert witness services.
YOUR TASKS:
Your key tasks and responsibilities will be:
• Lead the civil engineering aspects of energy projects—from concept to detailed design—delivering drawings, specs, estimates, and schedules.
• Provide technical guidance, review designs, and help resolve project challenges with practical, hands-on expertise;
• Prepare clear, accurate reports and documentation, and support site activities through inspections and construction monitoring;
• Identify and mitigate risks related to health & safety, design, sustainability, and commercial factors;
• Represent the company professionally, support business development, and mentor junior engineers.

Qualifications
YOUR PROFILE:
• You hold a minimum 2:1 degree in civil engineering.
• Chartered Engineer status;
• Detailed working knowledge of codes and standards used within the UK energy sector (Eurocodes and British Standards).
Experience of one or more of the following would be an advantage but not essential:
• Detailed civil/structural design experience, including foundation design;
• Condition and structural assessment of existing structures to determine suitability for reuse;
• Energy project experience;
• Experience in the scoping of and management of site surveys and investigations;
• Previous experience of providing consulting services in a multi-disciplinary engineering environment;
• Experience of working with CAD software such as Revit and AutoCAD;
• Understanding of the use of design tools within a BIM environment.
WHAT WE CAN OFFER:
• Exciting and challenging projects.
• Personal development opportunities (e.g., technical expert, project management)
• Friendly working atmosphere in a multidisciplinary and international team with a lot of personal responsibility
• Helping to shape a sustainable future

Additional Information
Available office locations for this position are either London, Oxford and Horsham.  We are ﬂexible on the office location for this position, please indicate your preference in your covering letter.  We value a healthy work life balance and are committed to your wellbeing. We will consider a range of flexible working arrangements, including part-time, flexible working patterns and we operate a hybrid working environment.
We offer an excellent range of benefits, including 25 days holiday each year, private medical insurance, life assurance and a pension scheme.  We also offer enhanced maternity and paternity pay offering 16 weeks full pay for both parents. This is supported by generous family support options such as, back up childcare support and return to work coaching.
We are excited to receive your application, please ensure your cover letter not only sets out how you are a great fit for this role and confirm your right to work in the UK as this role does not include sponsorship for a Skilled Worker visa.
Should you be successful you will be invited for a telephone interview following which, a virtual face to face interview. To allow us to assess your skills in practice this will be accompanied by analytical reasoning exercises.
At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.

About This Job
We are seeking a motivated and commercially minded Surveyor to join our Rating team. The successful candidate will provide professional advice on business rates for a diverse portfolio of commercial properties, helping clients minimise liabilities, manage risk, and navigate the UK rating system.
The role offers exposure to a wide range of sectors including office, industrial, retail, leisure, logistics, and mixed-use developments, working with both occupiers and investors.
Key Responsibilities
• Manage a portfolio of commercial rating instructions across multiple property sectors.
• Prepare, review, and submit business rates appeals and proposals.
• Analyse rental evidence, valuation data, and market trends to support rating assessments.
• Conduct property inspections and collect relevant valuation information.
• Negotiate with the Valuation Office Agency (VOA) to achieve favourable rating outcomes.
• Advise clients on business rates liabilities, reliefs, exemptions, and mitigation strategies.
• Support clients through the Check, Challenge, Appeal (CCA) process.
• Prepare reports, valuation analyses, and client presentations.
• Build and maintain strong client relationships through proactive communication and high-quality service delivery.
• Work collaboratively with colleagues across valuation, agency, lease advisory, and property management teams.
• Monitor legislative and case law developments affecting business rates.
• Assist with business development initiatives and contribute to winning new instructions.

Qualifications
Skills & Experience
Essential
• Degree in Real Estate, Estate Management, Surveying, or a related discipline.
• Progressing towards or qualified as a Chartered Surveyor (MRICS), or equivalent relevant experience.
• Experience in commercial property rating or valuation.
• Strong analytical and numerical skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to interpret market evidence and valuation information.
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Desirable
• MRICS qualified.
• Experience of negotiating rating appeals with the VOA.
• Knowledge of the Check, Challenge, Appeal process.
• Familiarity with property databases and rating software.
• Existing client relationships or business development experience.
Personal Attributes
• Commercially aware with strong attention to detail.
• Client-focused and solutions-oriented.
• Confident negotiator with strong interpersonal skills.
• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and within a team.
• Willingness to travel for property inspections and client meetings when required.

Start your career working with businesses at the forefront of innovation. You’ll help clients prepare R&D and Patent Box claims, learn how changing legislation affects them and discover the innovative projects happening behind the scenes. Along the way, you’ll develop your technical knowledge, commercial awareness and confidence working with clients.
Work in the National Innovation Incentives team involves detailed expenditure reviews, client meetings and narrative writing, a great opportunity to develop your skills not just in financials, but client relationship building and in-depth report writing! • Are you curious, with a desire to understand how things work?
• Can you think critically, analyse information and draw conclusions from evidence?
• Are you interested in emerging technology, science, innovation and new ideas?
• Can you manage priorities, take ownership and meet deadlines?
• Do you enjoy building relationships and collaborating with people from different backgrounds?
• Are you adaptable and resilient when faced with something unfamiliar?
• Are you motivated to learn and continuously develop your skills?

• Meeting the people behind the ideas, including engineers, software developers, scientists and other specialists, to understand the challenges they’re solving.

We tackle the most complex problems in quantitative finance, by bringing scientific clarity to financial complexity.
From our London HQ, we unite world-class researchers and engineers in an environment that values deep exploration and methodical execution - because the best ideas take time to evolve.  Together we’re building a world-class platform to amplify our teams’ most powerful ideas.
Join a research team where curiosity meets scale. You’ll investigate foundational questions, uncover market insights and push the boundaries of what's possible - all with the support of near-limitless compute and world-class peers.
Take the next step in your career.
The role
Our researchers have a challenge: disproving the efficient market hypothesis every day. This requires them to harness massive compute power and to use state-of-the-art ML techniques – published in recent conferences or developed entirely in-house – as textbook methods won’t beat the competition.
ML is integral to develop successful investment management strategies; it is one of the core drivers of our overall performance and success. It has long been a key tool at G-Research and we count a range of ICML and NeurIPS published researchers among our people.
Our ML practitioners have huge amounts of (clean) data and near infinite compute at their fingertips, with which they’re incentivised to explore the cutting-edge and find the 1% of difference. And unlike pure problems, our researchers get near instantaneous feedback in the form of absolute numbers where success is highly measurable and has a direct impact on the business.
As a team, we read the latest publications in the field and discuss them within the our vibrant, collaborative research community, and attend the leading conferences worldwide, such as NeurIPS and ICML.
In this research role you will be able to develop and test your ideas with real-world data in an academic environment.
Who are we looking for?
The ideal candidate will have:
• Either a post-graduate degree in machine learning or a related discipline, or commercial experience developing novel machine learning algorithms. We will also consider exceptional candidates with a proven record of success in online data science competitions, such as Kaggle
• Experience in one or more of deep learning, reinforcement learning, non-convex optimisation, Bayesian non-parametrics, NLP or approximate inference
• Excellent reasoning skills and mathematical ability are crucial: off-the-shelf methods don’t always work on our data so you will need to understand how to develop your own models
• Strong programming skills and experience working with Python, Scikit-Learn, SciPy, NumPy, Pandas and Jupyter Notebooks is desirable. Experience with object-oriented programming is beneficial
• Publications at top conferences, such as NeurIPS, ICML or ICLR, is highly desirable
Why should you apply?
• Highly competitive compensation plus annual discretionary bonus
• Lunch provided (via Just Eat for Business) and dedicated barista bar
• 35 days’ annual leave
• 9% company pension contributions
• Informal dress code and excellent work/life balance
• Comprehensive healthcare and life assurance
• Cycle-to-work scheme
• Monthly company events
G-Research is committed to cultivating and preserving an inclusive work environment. We are an ideas-driven business and we place great value on diversity of experience and opinions.

An exciting opportunity to join our growing Neurology team
Following the continued growth and development of our Neurology service, alongside internal progression within the team, we are delighted to be looking to welcome an additional Referral Veterinary Nurse to our department. This is an exciting opportunity to join a well-established and supportive team and play an important role in the continued development of our neurology service.
Our Neurology team within the hospital currently consists of four neurology clinicians, one neurology intern, two neurology nurses and one neurology technician. The department is also supported by our anaesthesia and multidisciplinary nursing teams.
Your Role
Primarily as a neurology nurse, you will assist with consults, admits and discharges, nursing neurology patients, administering chemotherapy, and monitoring sedation and general anaesthesia for imaging, investigations and surgery.
We require all our associates to work closely with other hospital associates at all times to ensure efficient case throughput and gold standard patient and client experiences. All members of the nursing team are jointly responsible for maintaining high standards of hygiene, equipment care, effective stock control and rotation.

Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
Team:  Pipeline Squad
Product: Jetstream — PTC's Atlas SaaS collaboration platform
About the team
The Pipeline squad owns the infrastructure, build, release, and security foundations that every other Jetstream squad builds on top of. Jetstream is a NestJS + Angular monorepo deployed into Azure Kubernetes via Helm, shipped through GitLab CI/CD, and running on the wider PTC Atlas platform. We're the squad that makes shipping fast, safe, and boring so product squads can focus on features.
What you will do:
• Work on services from development through to deployment and running them in production.
• Build and maintain backend services, mainly using TypeScript, Node.js and NestJS.
• Help improve our GitLab CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, security and deployment.
• Work with Docker, Kubernetes and Helm to deploy and troubleshoot our services.
• Improve developer tooling and workflows, particularly where we can remove manual work or make things simpler.
• Help improve observability, monitoring and debugging across our services.
• Work alongside DevOps on infrastructure and automation where needed, including things like Terraform and Azure.
• Generally be comfortable working across backend development, CI/CD and the platform rather than focusing only on application code.
Experience:
• Strong backend development experience, ideally TypeScript/Node.js/NestJS.
• Good CI/CD experience, ideally GitLab CI.
• Good experience with Docker and some practical Kubernetes experience.
• Experience deploying and troubleshooting services, not just developing them locally.
• A good understanding of testing, debugging, logging and monitoring.
• Comfortable working across application and infrastructure/deployment areas.
• Helm, Terraform and Azure/AKS experience would be useful, but I wouldn't make all of these hard requirements.
• Experience with PostgreSQL, APIs and asynchronous/messaging systems would also be useful given the services we work with.
Nice to have:
• Experience creating agentic development workflows or writing and maintaining AI skills.
• npm workspaces / shared-package build systems.
• Experience supporting SaaS platforms with strict data-privacy requirements (enterprise/multinational customers).
How we work:
• We favor paved paths and sensible defaults over teams maintaining highly custom setups.
• Simplicitiy - the art of maximising the amount of work not done - is essential.
• Developers work end-to-end to solve customer problems, and our tooling encourages end-to-end workflows over platform components.
Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

As a Consents Manager, you will lead environmental compliance and consent management activities throughout the post-consent phase of major projects. You will act as a trusted advisor to clients, ensuring that consent requirements, planning conditions, commitments, and legal obligations are effectively managed and discharged.
Key Responsibilities
•
Lead and deliver Environmental Consents Manager and Post-Consent Compliance Manager roles on major infrastructure projects from consent through construction.

Develop and implement consent management and compliance strategies to support project delivery and reduce environmental and regulatory risk.

Establish and maintain comprehensive consents, commitments, and obligations registers, ensuring requirements are clearly tracked and managed.

Provide oversight of consent compliance processes and ensure project teams understand and fulfil environmental commitments.

Support and lead environmental compliance audits, inspections, and regulatory reviews.

Prepare clear and concise reports on compliance status, emerging risks, and consent-related matters for clients, regulators, and senior project leadership.
•
Collaborate closely with engineering, environmental, planning, legal, and construction teams to ensure effective integration of consent requirements into project delivery.
•
Support business development through proposal preparation, client engagement, presentations, and thought leadership initiatives.
•
Mentor and develop junior team members, contributing to a positive and collaborative team culture.
Why This Role Matters
The successful delivery of major infrastructure projects depends on effective environmental compliance and robust consent management. As a Principal Consultant, you will help clients navigate complex regulatory frameworks, maintain compliance throughout construction, and deliver projects responsibly and sustainably.
Your expertise will play a critical role in managing environmental risk, protecting project programmes, and ensuring projects achieve their objectives while meeting regulatory expectations and environmental commitments.
What We're Looking For
•
Experience in environmental consent management, post-consent compliance, or environmental project delivery within the UK infrastructure sector.

Degree (or equivalent qualification) in Environmental Management, Environmental Planning, Geography, Ecology, Engineering, Law, or a related discipline.

Proven experience supporting or leading the discharge of consent requirements, planning conditions, and environmental commitments on major infrastructure projects.

Strong understanding of UK planning and consenting regimes, including:

Development Consent Orders (DCOs)

Town and Country Planning Act
•
Electricity Act Section 36 Consents
•
Associated environmental permitting and licensing requirements

Knowledge of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), environmental legislation, and the practical implementation of mitigation and monitoring commitments during construction.
•
Excellent stakeholder management skills with experience engaging clients, regulators, contractors, and multidisciplinary project teams.
•
Strong organisational and analytical skills, including management of complex compliance, legal, and regulatory requirements.
•
Experience preparing compliance reports, consent submissions, and regulatory correspondence.
•
Excellent communication, project management, and problem-solving skills.
Desirable

Experience managing environmental compliance during construction phases of major infrastructure projects.

Experience working within sectors such as transmission and distribution, renewable energy, hydrogen, solar, or wind.
•
Professional membership of a relevant institution (IEMA, RTPI, CIWEM, CEnv or equivalent).
•
Line management or mentoring experience.

You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy solving complex challenges, and are passionate about helping infrastructure projects achieve high environmental standards.

Do you want to work on real-time projects alongside leading scientists and engineers within a globally renowned company?

In addition to working with our highly skilled engineers and business professionals, successful completion of an Industrial Placement can often lead to an offer for a permanent graduate position and securing your place on our industry leading Graduate Development Programme.
This programme is remunerated £26,228 per annum.
A 6 month – 1 year Industrial Placement Programme
Our Industrial Placement Programme is designed to offer you the opportunity to develop the knowledge and skills you require to become an engineering or business professional of the future. On our programme you will engage with challenging and exciting project work, and deliver innovative business or technical solutions as part of a team of subject matter experts. Throughout the programme you will receive coaching and support from your team to achieve your objectives as well as your personal development goals. You will gain a wide array of experience on your placement that you can apply to your academic studies and future career.
At Leonardo we value individuals who continuously demonstrate a dedication to their personal development. We are looking for highly motivated individuals who are willing to take on a challenge to complete a placement, and we will demand a high degree of customer focus and work performance from you in order to meet our operational challenges. If you are willing to commit to giving your best performance, you will find Leonardo a very rewarding place to work!
Successful completion of an Industrial Placement with Leonardo may also lead to an offer on our Graduate Development Programme.

What you’ll do
Systems Engineers are involved in all aspects of design and development; from initial product design through to in-service support.
They look at the big picture, determine how the system needs to operate and collaborate to produce the required overall operational behaviours. They also dive into the deepest level of detail – taking the system piece-by-piece and defining its design to the finest point. Our Systems Engineers can also actively engage in R&D, developing new concepts and conducting fundamental research into our future technologies.
As a Industrial Placement Systems Engineer, you will work on real engineering problems within either the Radar or the Advanced Targeting business area. You will have the opportunity to be involved in supporting a wide range of tasks across multiple projects/products, such as:

• Our family of Surveillance AESA (Active Electronically Scanned Array) radars

• Our laser target designator or laser ranging systems

• The ability to develop effective working relationships with peers and stakeholders

This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all of the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.

For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV).  As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.
To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years.  In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.  Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.

Company Overview
Brown & Brown Claims
Brown & Brown is the 5th largest intermediary business in the world with over 23,000 teammates and offices throughout the US and Europe. Brown & Brown Claims is the in-house claims team responsible for handling claims on behalf of the international underwriting division. The department manages a diverse portfolio of household, commercial and liability claims, supporting customers from first notification of loss through to settlement while delivering excellent customer outcomes and maintaining strong insurer relationships.
Role Summary
Purpose of Role
Reporting directly to the Senior Claims Supervisor, the Liability Claims Handler is responsible for the investigation, validation, negotiation and settlement of Third-Party Property Damage (TPPD) claims arising under combined liability insurance policies.
Whilst the primary focus of the role is the handling of Third-Party Property Damage claims, the successful candidate will also manage a small allocation of lower-value Personal Injury claims. This will include minor injury and straightforward bodily injury matters, requiring the handler to assess medical evidence, evaluate quantum, consider causation and negotiate settlements in line with insurer philosophy and prevailing claims protocols. An understanding of personal injury claims handling principles is therefore highly desirable and will support effective management of the wider liability portfolio.
This is a technically focused claims handling role requiring a strong understanding of liability principles, insurance policy coverage, evidential requirements and litigation risk. The postholder will independently manage a caseload of claims ranging from straightforward incidents through to complex and disputed liability matters involving substantial third-party losses.
The Claims Handler will work closely with policyholders, claimants, brokers, insurers, solicitors, engineers, loss adjusters and other stakeholders to ensure claims are resolved efficiently whilst controlling indemnity spend, reducing lifecycle times and protecting insurer interests.
Accurate and timely maintenance of claim files and management information on the Pro-Claim claims management system is an essential requirement.
Company Overview

• Manage a portfolio of Third-Party Liability claims from first notification through to settlement and closure.
• Manage a small portfolio of low-value Personal Injury claims, including liability assessment, review of medical evidence, reserve management and claims settlement.
• Review incident circumstances and determine liability based on available evidence, legal precedent and insurer strategy.
• Analyse photographs, witness statements, engineering reports, repair estimates, invoices and other supporting documentation.
• Conduct detailed liability investigations and identify potential fraud indicators, policy breaches or coverage concerns.

• Assess injury claims in accordance with relevant legislation, claims protocols and insurer handling guidelines.
• Negotiate injury settlements with claimants, representatives and third-party insurers to achieve fair and commercially sound outcomes.
• Ensure all reserves are reviewed regularly and maintained at accurate levels in accordance with claims handling guidelines.
• Proactively manage claim lifecycles to minimise unnecessary delays and meet agreed service standards.
• Escalate technically complex, high-value or litigated claims where required.
• Ensure compliance with insurer authorities, delegated claims handling agreements and internal governance requirements.
• Maintain accurate and comprehensive file notes and claim documentation on the Pro-Claim system.
• Respond to incoming correspondence, emails and telephone enquiries within agreed service standards.
• Liaise effectively with suppliers, engineers, loss adjusters and legal representatives to facilitate claim progression.
• Identify customer vulnerabilities and ensure all customers receive fair treatment in line with regulatory expectations.
• Maintain the company's ethical standards, values and commitment to delivering excellent customer service.

Preferred Qualifications
• Cert CII qualification desirable with progress towards Dip CII qualification advantageous.
• Minimum 3 years’ experience handling Third Party Property Damage claims within an insurer, MGA, broker or third-party administrator environment.
• Previous experience handling Personal Injury claims is highly desirable. Working knowledge of bodily injury claims, medical reporting, causation principles and quantum assessment would be advantageous.

• Strong understanding of Third-Party Property Damage claims handling processes.
• Understanding of Personal Injury claims handling processes and relevant claims protocols.

NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
•
Job Title: Electrician
•
Salary: £39,156.00 per annum
•
Hours: 40 Hours per week, permanent position
•
Location: Visiting various sites throughout the UK (all lodge costs covered by company and stop-away allowance applicable)
What is the role of an Electrician?
Your role will primarily involve works associated with the installation, de-installation or maintenance of ATMs.
You are expected to hold a valid JIB Installation Electrician Grade Card and all relevant/current C&G Awards relating to Electrical Installation and Inspection & Testing.
Electricians primarily work out of our Rotherham facility but can also be based remotely covering works throughout specific regions of the UK.  With advance notice you must be able to stay away from home if required by your schedule of works (all lodge costs covered by company and stop-away allowance applicable).
What will I be doing as an Electrician?
Communicate effectively with the Rotherham-based electrical team on matters including:
•
Site-specific scopes of work.
•
Material lists, collection from Rotherham and/or UK wholesalers etc.
•
Resolving unforeseen issues on site.
•
Health & Safety matters.
•
Site sign-off documentation.
•
Undertake pre-contract surveys to confirm safety of site electrical installations.
•
Complete electrical installation, repair and maintenance works using varied methods on ATM sites.
•
Test and certify new and existing electrical circuits associated with the ATM.
•
Complete In-Service Inspection & Testing of ATMs and associated electrical equipment.
•
Work in line with site-specific Risk Assessments and Method Statements.
What will I need to succeed as an Electrician?
•
Applicants should demonstrate a sound knowledge of the Electricity at Work Regulations 1989, have a valid JIB Electrical Installation Grade Card and hold qualifications including:
•
City & Guilds 2330 Level 2 & Level 3 (or equivalent)
•
City & Guilds 2382-22: Level 3 Award in Requirements for Electrical Installations 18th Edition
•
City & Guilds 2391-52: Level 3 Award in the Inspection, Testing & Documentation of Electrical Installations
•
City & Guilds 2377-77: Level 3 Award in the In-service Inspection & Testing of Electrical Equipment
•
Ability to work independently or as part of a team collaborating with Installation teams and/or approved sub-contractors as required.
•
IT ability including use of Microsoft Outlook and Teams and completion of electronic site survey documents and certification using Tysoft and iAuditor applications.
•
Strong time-management and organisation skills to ensure sites are completed in line with the Schedule of Works.
•
General Health & Safety knowledge (Manual Handling, Work at Height, Asbestos Awareness etc.)
•
UKPIA-SPA Petrol Forecourt training (desirable not essential).
•
Clean UK Driving Licence.
This job description is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, efforts, or working conditions associated with the job.  While it is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or require that other or different tasks be performed.
As an Electrician, we can offer you the following:
•
Salary £39,156.00 per annum
•
24 days holiday, rising to 25 after 5 years’ service.
•
Competitive defined contribution company pension with Fidelity.
•
75% Employer funded single private medical cover, with the option to buy additional cover.
•
Access to opt into a range of competitively priced benefits, including health cash plan, dental cover, cancer checks, health assessments, critical illness cover and cycle to work scheme.
•
Employee life assurance.
•
Employer funded Income protection scheme.
•
Employee Assistance Programme, with 24/7 counselling service, virtual GP appointments and support for a range of topics.
•
Access to a wide range of retail discounts to high street and online stores including supermarkets, utilities, entertainment, travel, car hire/transport, food & drink.
•
Access to MYGYM discounts for membership offers and discounts.

Senior Low Latency Java Engineer - Equities Electronic- Execution (eTrading)
Engineer the future of global finance. At Citi, our Tech team doesn’t just support finance – we are helping to redefine it. Every day, $5 trillion crosses through our network. We do business in 180+ countries operating at a scale few can match. From deploying advanced AI to helping shape global markets, we build systems that matter. Look to join a team where your work helps influence economies, your ideas can drive innovation and outcomes, and your growth is backed by mentorship, continuous learning and flexibility with potential hybrid work opportunities. Help solve real-world challenges that touch millions and get the opportunity to build the future of finance with Citi Tech.
What We do / The Team
Equities Technology at Citi is undertaking a bold, multi‑year transformation to build a best‑in‑class global platform across execution, prime, clearing and cross‑product margining. We are re‑engineering our technology estate to achieve world‑leading performance and resiliency, enabling new capabilities in advanced execution, global market connectivity, and modernised post‑trade, clearing and margin processes. Our ambition is to deliver a seamlessly integrated, highly automated platform that drives outstanding client outcomes and accelerates growth across our global franchise. As part of the team, you’ll collaborate closely with high‑calibre engineers and deeply engaged business and product partners - working together to define and deliver the next generation of Equities technology at Citi.
Role Overview
Citi's Equities Technology organization is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Equities Electronic- Execution (Electronic Trading) technology team. The person in this role will be responsible for the design, development, and delivery of Citi's next-generation low-latency execution platform. This platform encompasses critical components including Algorithmic Trading, Smart Order Routing (SOR), Dark Pool & Internalization engines, Low latency Client & Exchange Connectivity, and high-throughput market data processing.
The senior engineer will collaborate with a cross-functional team of developers and work closely with product development, quantitative research, technology infrastructure, production support and QA teams. Close alignment with the global strategy and cross-regional delivery is a key aspect of this role. This is a leadership role requiring prior experience in building high performance Electronic Trading platforms and leading high performance development teams.
• Core Development: Design, development and maintenance of high-performance, low-latency electronic execution systems
• Product Collaboration: Partner with traders, quant researchers, and clients to understand their needs and translate them into innovative product features and enhancements — including execution performance improvements, new liquidity sources, and DMA capabilities.
• Testing: Continuously improve and maintain testing frameworks, development tools, and environments to ensure platform reliability and performance at scale.
• AI-Powered SDLC: Leverage Citi's suite of AI-powered development tools throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) to enhance productivity, code quality, and innovation.
• Agile & CI/CD: Contribute to and champion Agile development practices and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) processes with a focus on shift-left testing and accelerated release cycles.
• Platform Support & Enhancement: Build and maintain common solutions for trading platform monitoring, trade reconciliation, application recovery, and other essential support functions.
What you will bring
• Extensive  experience with strong technical knowledge and expertise in Low Latency Java,
• Strong understanding of automated testing techniques and quality engineering practices.
• Solid understanding of Agile methodologies and Continuous Integration processes.
• Familiarity with low-latency system design, including performance optimization, concurrency, and high-throughput architecture.
• Ability to prioritize multiple tasks, set goals, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment.
• Excellent communication skills with a demonstrable ability to present and grasp complex concepts in a multicultural, cross-regional environment.
• Knowledge of regional exchange microstructure and regulatory regimes.
Bonus points for:
• Coupled with extensive Java expertise, added programing skills and experience in C++ or Rust would be considered advantageous.
• Prior experience developing electronic trading platforms in a global financial institution or equivalent environment.
This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.
What we’ll provide you
By joining Citi, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as:
• 27 days annual leave (plus bank holidays)
• A discretional annual performance related bonus
• Private Medical Care & Life Insurance
• Employee Assistance Program
• Pension Plan
• Paid Parental Leave
• Special discounts for employees, family, and friends
• Access to an array of learning and development resources
Visit our About Us | Culture, Values & Benefits page to learn more.
Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self, every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay and empowered to thrive.

• Understand pladis’ business category strategy and communicate it effectively across procurement.

• Presenting sourcing strategies and recommendations to relevant forums
• Reporting on 5 key deliverable areas, including Jaggaer updates for all projects in the category

• Negotiation and commercial analytical skills Supplier/Customer relationship management experience or excellent inter-personnel skills with the ability to form strong working relationships
• Project management and leadership skills, including how to make a strong recommendation
• The ability to think strategically and set a 3 year category plan.
• The ability to lead many workstreams and work in a team whilst managing key stakeholders
• Demonstrate experience of developing, leading, and delivering change implementation within an organisation
• Excellent communication and influencing skills within the team and across the business.
