Help develop ontologies, taxonomies, and controlled vocabularies underpinning enterprise metadata and search

Define semantic modelling standards and patterns to ensure consistent meaning, interoperability, and AI readiness across data products
•
Guide and control the creation of data domains that align with the banks underlying capabilities

Design data product schemas across Snowflake and Databricks, including Delta Lake structures and access patterns

Define and enforce architectural guardrails for data product design, including performance, scalability, security, and cost efficiency

Embed data contract standards and data quality frameworks across pipeline outputs

Leverage Snowflake Cortex / Databricks Genie (or similar) to help engineering teams deliver natural language query and LLM-augmented data products

Utilize GitHub Copilot (or similar) to accelerate modelling, documentation, and pipeline development
•
Design and define a set of agentic skills that can be provided to implementation teams
•
Contribute to the firm's AI Champion network, evaluating emerging capabilities and advising on adoption

Act as a design authority for data architecture across teams and data domains

Partner with enterprise, security, and risk architecture to ensure data solutions align with broader technology and regulatory standards
•
Provide early-stage architectural input to initiative discovery and solution design to reduce delivery risk
Governance & Stakeholder Engagement
•
Present architecture decisions to senior stakeholders, architecture review boards, and regulatory audiences
•
Support regulatory compliance through robust lineage, metadata management, and data quality evidence
•
Mentor junior architects and engineers within the Information Architecture community of practice

Proven experience in data architecture, data engineering, or information management
•
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline

Proven enterprise data modelling experience at conceptual, logical, and physical levels
•
Hands-on SqlDBM experience (or equivalent modern toolset)
•
Proven experience with dbt Labs
•
Good Python skills, API integration, automation

Practical Snowflake and Databricks experience including Cortex AI and Genie

Working knowledge of OWL, RDF, SPARQL and enterprise ontology design

Experience with at least one agentic AI framework

GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI coding assistant experience in a professional setting

Data mesh, data product ownership and federated governance

Knowledge graph platforms (Neo4j, Neptune) or knowledge of OWL, RDF and exposure to and build of ontologies

Published thought leadership or community contributions in data or AI

• Monitor legal and regulatory developments affecting cross-border payments, money transmission, safeguarding, FX, stablecoins or digital assets where relevant, and treasury operations, and translate developments into practical guidance for business stakeholders.

• Experience with legal and regulatory frameworks relevant to money transmission, cross-border payments, AML/KYC, sanctions, consumer payments, safeguarding of funds, operational resilience, and operational risk.

Job Description:
We are looking for a Lead UX Researcher to join our Cybersecurity R&D team, reporting to the Head of UX.
This is a high-impact role within an established Product, Design and Engineering organisation, with a mandate to strengthen and scale UX research while helping shape Darktrace's unified platform strategy. As our products continue to evolve into a more connected experience, you will deepen our understanding of the people who use them, their goals, workflows and decision-making processes, and ensure those insights directly influence product direction.
Working closely with UX/UI, Product and Engineering teams, you will build a strong, evidence-based understanding of how security professionals operate across different domains, tools and environments. Your work will help guide strategic decisions, improve customer experiences and create a more connected research practice across our portfolio.
What will I be doing?
You will lead strategic and hands-on UX research that helps shape the future of Darktrace's cybersecurity platform. Working across multiple products, you will uncover customer needs, challenge assumptions and provide the insights that drive product strategy, platform design and user experience decisions.
Key responsibilities include:
• Defining and delivering a cross-product research roadmap, working with UX, Product and Engineering leaders to address the most important customer, product and platform questions.
• Conducting a broad range of qualitative and quantitative research, including interviews, contextual enquiry, usability testing, workflow analysis and concept validation.
• Identifying common user needs, behaviours and workflows across products, helping inform decisions around platform unification, navigation, information architecture and cross-product experiences.
• Translating research findings into clear, actionable outputs, such as personas, journey maps, workflow models and strategic recommendations that support decision-making across teams.
• Helping establish scalable research practices and a research-centred culture, enabling designers, product managers and engineers to build stronger customer understanding in their own work.
What experience do I need?
We're looking for an experienced UX researcher with a track record of influencing product strategy within complex software environments. You'll be comfortable working with senior stakeholders, navigating ambiguity and turning customer insights into meaningful business and product outcomes.
You'll ideally bring:
• Strong experience leading foundational and strategic UX research within B2B, enterprise or technically complex software organisations.
• A proven ability to influence product direction through evidence-based insights, working closely with Product, Design and Engineering teams.
• Deep expertise in qualitative research methods, alongside the ability to identify patterns and opportunities across complex user needs and workflows.
• Experience researching multi-product ecosystems, platforms or interconnected systems, with an understanding of how different user groups work across them.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience building or evolving UX research practices within a growing organisation.
Nice to Have
Experience within cybersecurity, security operations or other highly technical domains would be advantageous, as would exposure to platform transformation initiatives or large-scale enterprise workflows
